body:
🎀 CozyCraft | Cozy Survival Server (No PvP • No Resets • Java + Bedrock) 🌸

Looking for a peaceful Minecraft server where you can build without worrying your world will disappear?

Welcome to CozyCraft, a slow and cozy survival world focused on creativity, relaxing builds, and a friendly community.

✨ What makes CozyCraft special

💖 No PvP – we’re lovers, not fighters
🌷 No resets ever. Your builds stay forever
✨ No pay-to-win. Everyone plays fair
🍰 Mostly vanilla survival with a few cozy quality-of-life tweaks
🌼 Friendly, chill community

Build huge castles.
Build tiny cottages.
Build a little village by a lake.

Take your time. There is no rush and no wipes here.

Your creations deserve to stay. 💕

💻 Java: cozy-craft.org
📱 Bedrock: mc.cozy-craft.org:25590
💬 Discord: discord.cozy-craft.org

Come build something cozy with us. ☕
